final: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_usage FROM station_avgs) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_usage AS above_overall_average FROM station_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_usage ORDER BY above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10
